section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants of a study, which included two distinct samples. The primary sample consisted of 840 students (438 boys, 402 girls) from three Brazilian cities, with mean ages of 15.50 for boys and 15.51 for girls, and mean BMIs of 21.87 for boys and 21.67 for girls. A second independent sample of 46 students (19 boys, 27 girls), with a mean age of 14.02 and mean BMI of 20.32, was recruited to assess the temporal stability of the BAS-2 instrument.
